Valve Screen.name: Valve Screen
Valve Screen.description: The user vents a scalding-fog screen across a room until the end of their next turn, or focuses the release into a pressure valve jet at touch that bursts a jammed door or lifts a slab of rubble off someone trapped. Enemies entering the fog take fire damage and nobody can see through it; held back, it vents as warm mist that harms nobody and hides allies, though cold rooms condense it early. Strain: moderate.
